help_checks.output:
usage: private_demo_service.py [-h] --session SESSION
                               [--source-root SOURCE_ROOT] [--model MODEL]
                               [--device DEVICE] [--port PORT] [--image IMAGE]
                               [--lock-root LOCK_ROOT]
                               {start,stop,status}

Explicit single-NPU demo service lifecycle; never stops an existing service.
Run on the Linux host. New files live in --session; an existing local image is
required. start refuses an occupied NPU/project lease. stop only owns this
named container, and releases the lease only after Docker confirms it has
stopped.

positional arguments:
  {start,stop,status}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --session SESSION
  --source-root SOURCE_ROOT
  --model MODEL
  --device DEVICE
  --port PORT
  --image IMAGE
  --lock-root LOCK_ROOT

usage: prepare_private_demo_suite.py [-h] --source-suite SOURCE_SUITE --model
                                     MODEL --out OUT [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS]

Freeze a new small-model demo protocol from existing verified public samples.
Does not change the source suite, prompts, rules or detector thresholds. This
is a new 512-token demo, not a replay of the historical 1024-token Qwen32B
evidence.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --source-suite SOURCE_SUITE
  --model MODEL
  --out OUT
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS

usage: interactive_inspect.py [-h] [--base-url BASE_URL]
                              [--api-key-file API_KEY_FILE] [--args ARGS]
                              [--output OUTPUT] [--adapter ADAPTER]
                              [--confirm-lossless]
                              {status,list,describe,observe,poll,stop,candidates,export,validate,recorded}

Developer CLI: list -> describe -> observe -> candidates -> export ->
validate. No model requests or mutation by default. Observe opens a bounded
window and returns.

positional arguments:
  {status,list,describe,observe,poll,stop,candidates,export,validate,recorded}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base-url BASE_URL
  --api-key-file API_KEY_FILE
  --args ARGS           JSON kwargs, not executable Python
  --output OUTPUT
  --adapter ADAPTER     explicit trusted LOCAL lifecycle factory
                        module:function; only validate
  --confirm-lossless

usage: run_model_target_plan_live.py [-h] --session SESSION
                                     [--deployment DEPLOYMENT]
                                     [--discover-only] [--plan PLAN]
                                     [--roles ROLES [ROLES ...]]
                                     [--multiplier MULTIPLIER]
                                     [--max-prompt-tokens MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS]
                                     --suite SUITE --identity-probe
                                     IDENTITY_PROBE --probe PROBE [PROBE ...]
                                     --out OUT

Run an explicit plan through the existing leased lab owner (no launch/lock).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --session SESSION
  --deployment DEPLOYMENT
                        Explicit private-service deployment; no legacy lab
                        paths
  --discover-only       Observe real clean input and export disabled plan;
                        never install/arm
  --plan PLAN
  --roles ROLES [ROLES ...]
  --multiplier MULTIPLIER
  --max-prompt-tokens MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS
  --suite SUITE
  --identity-probe IDENTITY_PROBE
  --probe PROBE [PROBE ...]
  --out OUT

usage: summarize_private_demo.py [-h] --evaluation EVALUATION --out OUT

Offline new-user walkthrough/report from real TargetPlan and raw B/F/R. Reuse
EvaluationResult and the existing scorer/Dashboard. No generation, arm, new
thresholds, LLM judge or invented task/probability measurements.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --evaluation EVALUATION
  --out OUT

                             HEAD --out OUT

Read-only provenance snapshot after a completed private demo; no model calls.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --session SESSION
  --branch BRANCH
  --head HEAD
  --out OUT

usage: audit_source_baseline.py [-h] [--manifest MANIFEST]
                                [--inventory INVENTORY]
                                [--evidence-root EVIDENCE_ROOT] --out OUT
                                {inventory,verify,links,freeze,tests}

Offline source/documentation inventory and release checks; never starts
services. All outputs are new files. No historical manifests, evidence or
other worktrees are rewritten. This helper is not a runtime, installer or
fault controller.

positional arguments:
  {inventory,verify,links,freeze,tests}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --manifest MANIFEST
  --inventory INVENTORY
  --evidence-root EVIDENCE_ROOT
  --out OUT
